taxonomies.name: Ergonomic Features
taxonomies.definition: Physical design elements that affect handling and user comfort, e.g. grip surfaces, holding mechanisms

taxonomies.name: Material Composition
taxonomies.definition: Chemical and ingredient properties of arts and crafts materials, e.g. allergen content, toxicity levels

taxonomies.name: Physical Structure and Integrity
taxonomies.definition: Physical form, construction quality, and structural soundness of arts and crafts products and their packaging, e.g. pencil straightness, box construction durability, shape distortion, container lid mechanisms

taxonomies.name: Writing Tip Condition and Performance
taxonomies.definition: Physical state and functionality of pencil, marker, or crayon tips and points, e.g. tip durability, sharpness retention, breakage resistance, point wear patterns

taxonomies.name: Color Visual Properties
taxonomies.definition: Visual color characteristics including variety, intensity, and appearance of arts and crafts materials, e.g. color selection range, brightness levels, pigment vibrancy

taxonomies.name: Product Size and Dimensions
taxonomies.definition: Physical measurements and sizing specifications of arts and crafts products, e.g. container volume, item proportions for age groups, length and width specifications

taxonomies.name: Tactile Surface Properties
taxonomies.definition: Physical texture and feel characteristics of arts and crafts materials during use, e.g. smoothness, softness, surface consistency, grip texture
